def person(name):return next(r for r in s.values() if r['kind']=='story_element' and r['display_name']==name)
def new_character(name,fragment):
 r=t.base('story_element',fragment);r.update(element_type='character',display_name=name,aliases=[],status='accepted',assertion_ids=[],relationship_ids=[],dependency_refs=[],time_ref=None,decision_ids=[]);return t.add(r)
project=next(r for r in s.values() if r['kind']=='novel_project')
direction='Edda must remain innocent of the murder.'
pr=records.revise_project(project,{'review_preferences':{'routine_checkpoint':'session_close'},'creative_directions':[x['text'] for x in project['creative_directions']]+[direction]},t.p)
pr['source_refs']=[t.src('Set routine checkpoints to session close'),t.src(direction)];pr['creative_directions'][-1]['source_refs']=[t.src(direction)];t.add(pr)
events=next(r for r in s.values() if r['kind']=='session' and r['topic']=='Events');t.p['session_id']=events['id']
changes=[];impacts=[];new_records=[]
def replace_fact(name,old_assert_id,fragment,subject,predicate,value,statement,new_subject=False,revise_subject=False,newtime=None):
 olda=s[old_assert_id]
 oldi=next(r for r in s.values() if r['kind']=='idea' and olda['id'] in r['resulting_assertion_ids'] and r['status']=='accepted')
 oa=t.revise(olda,fragment);oa['status']='superseded'
 oi=t.revise(oldi,fragment);oi['status']='superseded'
 na=t.assertion(subject,predicate,value,fragment,'accepted');na['supersedes']=ref(olda)

 results=[oa,oi,na,ni];targets=[olda,oldi]
 if new_subject:
  subject['assertion_ids'].append(na['id']);results.append(subject)
 elif revise_subject:
  original=subject;subject=t.revise(original,fragment);subject['assertion_ids'].append(na['id']);results.append(subject);targets.append(original)
  if newtime:subject['time_ref']=copy.deepcopy(newtime)
 if newtime:na['time_ref']=copy.deepcopy(newtime)
 d=t.decision('revise',fragment,targets,results,[statement],'Explicitly replace the identified fact; supersede the current old assertion and idea while retaining all earlier revisions.',[olda,oldi])
 inspected=json.loads((e/('AUTH_REVISE-inspect-'+name+'.json')).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'));assert inspected['ok']
 affected=inspected['data']['directly_affected']
 d['review_required_refs']=[ref(r) for r in affected]
 for r in results:
  if 'decision_ids' in r:r['decision_ids'].append(d['id'])
 new_records.extend(results+[d])
 changes.append(name+': '+statement+' New fact '+cite(na)+'; idea '+cite(ni)+'; revision decision '+cite(d)+'. Prior fact '+cite(olda)+' and idea '+cite(oldi)+' remain inspectable; their current versions '+cite(oa)+' and '+cite(oi)+' are superseded.')
 impacts.append(name+': '+', '.join(cite(r)+' ('+r['kind']+')' for r in affected)+'.')
 return d,na,ni

brother=next(r for r in s.values() if r['kind']=='relationship' and r['meaning']=='brother of')
sister=next(r for r in s.values() if r['kind']=='relationship' and r['meaning']=='sister of')

reply=t.checkpoint_summary(intro,requested=True,extra=extra)
review={'coverage':'complete','reviewed_record_refs':[ref(r) for r in s.values() if r.get('status')=='accepted']+[ref(oldwhy),ref(r) for r in []] if False else [ref(r) for r in s.values() if r.get('status')=='accepted']+[ref(oldwhy)],'unavailable_refs':[],'canon_hold_refs':[],'finding_ids':[],'summary':'Applied the five explicit canon substitutions with precise supersession, retaining original sources and prior versions.
